Welcome to the digital setup for Vindhya Spices & Preserves Pvt. Ltd. 
We are based out of Plot No 45, Sanwer Road Industrial Area, Indore, MP 452015. 
Our GSTIN is 23AABCV1234E1Z5. 

We deal exclusively in INR (Indian Rupee). 
Our main banking is done through HDFC Bank, Palasia Branch. 

We have been manufacturing authentic Indian pickles and ground spices since 2010. 
Please set up the system so we can track our raw mangoes, chillies, cold-pressed oils, and empty glass jars, along with our finished retail products. We need to strictly track our payables to local farmers and receivables from supermarkets.
